title: Terrible print job -- maps illegible
text: Terrible print job -- maps illegible. I ordered these thinking they were similar to ones our family had in the 1970s. Those were laminated and had crisp, clear printing. These are not laminated -- I knew that buying them. The printing is so blurry as to be unreadable...it's as if no one looked at the finished product before selling it. Basically worthless except to put under  table items. As entertaining placemats these are terrible
